title: (LEAD) S. Korea, U.S. agree to postpone key bilateral security dialogue to early next year: Seoul
caption:
South Korea and the U.S. have rescheduled their annual security dialogue to early 2025. The delay highlights ongoing complexities regarding the transition of wartime operational control.
